entries.label: Lobito — chambre de KODOQUE
entries.scene: The original Metal Gear AC!D FAR underground KODOQUE chamber, using the screenshots but entirely OMITTING Kodoque and characters. Preserve towering plain dark olive steel wall panels with vertical reinforced pilasters, an upper service catwalk with thin railings, lower steel grating walkways bordered by worn yellow-black caution stripes, a simple open rectangular doorway and red-brown vent panel from reference 2, sparse cold blue industrial light with warm dull brown floor panels. This is an enclosed tall 2004 PSP industrial machine chamber. No glowing reactor, no huge decorative machinery invented to replace the robot, no neon turquoise AC!D2 color scheme. Empty flat foreground maintenance walkway with tall panel walls behind.
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE opaque wide 16:9 static fighting-game stage background plate for CQC, closely grounded in the supplied original PSP/game screenshots. Input images are REFERENCE SCREENSHOTS or chronological reference contact sheets only. Output one continuous environment, never a grid or collage. Ignore all characters, menus, HUD, cards, facecam, video branding and subtitles in the references. Preserve towering plain dark olive steel wall panels with vertical reinforced pilasters, an upper service catwalk with thin railings, lower steel grating walkways bordered by worn yellow-black caution stripes, a simple open rectangular doorway and red-brown vent panel from reference 2, sparse cold blue industrial light with warm dull brown floor panels. This is an enclosed tall 2004 PSP industrial machine chamber. No glowing reactor, no huge decorative machinery invented to replace the robot, no neon turquoise AC!D2 color scheme. Keep the reference materials, architecture and palette; no unreferenced redesign. No people, enemies, logos, UI, captions or watermark. Detailed faithful game-rendered environment.

notes: Chambre KODOQUE AC!D contrôlée : panneaux métalliques hauts, passerelles, porte et palette sombre ; robot absent.
Couverture partielle FAR : extérieur et segment intérieur Teliko non couverts. Les zones cachées par le boss sont reconstituées.
